I went through all 78 rules in the convention checklist against `git diff 6d854db86...HEAD` (23 files, +580/−233). The PR has no blocking convention failures. I found 2 medium and 5 low findings, plus 2 notes that fall outside the rules. I didn't need to look up any rule's review-learning history or GitHub source.

The only thing written to disk is the checklist file `docs/engineering/pr-self-review-checklist.generated.md`, with every item ticked. It sits under `docs/engineering/`, which is untracked, so no tracked files changed. I didn't run tests or `gh`.

## Findings

### Medium

**1. PROD-01 / UX-03: The Safe address book loses its rows-per-page selector and its mobile card layout**
- `apps/web/src/components/address-book/AddressBookTable/index.tsx:221`
- `EnhancedTable` offered 10, 25 or 100 rows per page. `PaginatedDataTable` has a fixed page size of 25, and the `@deprecated` note at `apps/web/src/components/common/EnhancedTable/index.tsx:138` already says it has no rows-per-page option.
- The custom mobile card view is also gone: it and `styles.module.css` (−80 lines) are replaced by responsive column dropping.
- Users will see both changes, so the PR description should say design/product signed off on them.
- The default of 25 still matches Cypress's `verifyCountOfSafes(25)`.

**2. CODE-01 / CODE-02: The compact "icon + tooltip + aria-label" pattern is written out four times**
- `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/AddToWorkspaceButton.tsx:98-103`
- `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/RequestToAddButton.tsx:103-112` and `:128-135`
- `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/index.tsx:193-205`
- Each copy does the same thing: when `isCompact`, swap the label for a lucide icon, move the label into `aria-label` and a tooltip, and wrap it in `<TooltipTrigger render={<span className="inline-flex" />}>`.
- A small `CompactLabel` or `IconWithTooltip` component in `SpaceAddressBook/` would name it once and keep the accessibility handling consistent.

### Low

**3. CODE-01 / FEAT-01: Three copies of the "name with the address underneath when compact" cell**
- `SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:89-100` and `PendingRequestsTable.tsx:158-169` share the new `AddressCell`.
- The Safe address book rebuilds the same layout inline with different `EthHashInfo` props (`apps/web/src/components/address-book/AddressBookTable/index.tsx:167-183`). It can't import `AddressCell`, because that lives inside `features/spaces` and FEAT-01 forbids reaching into a feature's internals.
- `PaginatedDataTable` just moved to `components/common` for this reason. Moving `AddressCell` next to it, or into `components/address-book`, would let all three tables share one cell.

**4. TEST-02 / TEST-04: The branches that replace the Safe address book's mobile layout have no tests**
- `apps/web/src/components/address-book/AddressBookTable/index.test.tsx` only tests pagination with `useIsMobile` returning false.
- Nothing tests the compact name cell (address under the name, name not truncated) at `index.tsx:171-182`, or that the Address column (`priority: 'secondary'`) is dropped on mobile. This new code replaces the deleted mobile card.
- The Spaces tables do have these tests (`SpaceAddressBookTable.test.tsx`, `PendingRequestsTable.test.tsx`).

**5. TEST-02: The compact state plus a name error isn't tested**
- `RequestToAddButton.tsx:139` and `AddToWorkspaceButton.tsx:89-91` send `nameError` through `InvalidContactNameTooltip` with the icon-only button. That path has no test.
- The compact "Already shared" icon badge (`SpaceAddressBook/index.tsx:193-205`) also has none.

**6. FEAT-04: The PR edits a file under `components/ui/*` without saying whether it's coordinated**
- `apps/web/src/components/ui/stories/design-system.stories.tsx:938-964`
- The rule requires the PR to state that it's coordinated with any open design-system rewrite of `components/ui/*`, or that no such PR is open. I couldn't check open PRs without `gh`, so this is a note to add to the PR description.

**7. E2E-01: The address-sort Cypress test reads the opposite of what it checks**
- `apps/web/cypress/e2e/regression/address_book_2.cy.js:33-37`
- After one click on the Address sort (ascending), it calls `verifyEntriesOrder('descending')`, because that helper's option means "by name".
- The new comment explains this, but a helper parameter that means the opposite of the action is easy to break later. Consider an explicit expected-first-row argument instead.
- The selectors themselves are fine. `PaginatedDataTable` now emits the `table-container`, `table-row`, `prev-page-btn` and `next-page-btn` test IDs that `main.page.js` relies on.

## Other notes (outside the rules)

- **Comment cut off mid-sentence:** `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/index.tsx:142` now ends at "…left the search almost touching", because its second line ("the table card below it.") was deleted.
- **Consumer count is now wrong:** `EnhancedTable/index.tsx:137` still says "its nine existing consumers" and the story at `design-system.stories.tsx:943` still says "~9". With the address book gone there are now 8. The story also says no consumer passes `panel` any more, which means `panel` is used only by the story.

## Rules that passed
- **API-01:** all imports of `PaginatedDataTable` moved to the new path, and nothing still uses the old one.
- **FEAT-01 / FEAT-03:** no feature-boundary or barrel self-import violations.
- **UX-01:** long names wrap with `wrap-anywhere` in compact mode.
- **UI-01:** new colours use theme tokens.
- **TEST-01:** the new tests would fail on the regressions they cover. The page-reset tests would fail against the old `useEffect([rows])` code.
- **TEST-05:** the Spaces tests use builders, and no unit test imports MSW fixtures.
